physical_constraints: 96-well plate: rows share temperature (8 unique values), columns share pH (12 unique values). Design 16 wells that fit on the plate.

strategy.rationale: Cold start with only 12 points in 2D. The yield surface is sharply peaked (median ~0.6 vs max ~99), so we need both exploration to map the landscape and exploitation near the promising region. Batch size of 16 exceeds 10, making Thompson sampling the natural choice: it provides diverse, well-spread batches via posterior sampling while still concentrating points in high-probability regions. No budget constraint, so balanced exploration/exploitation is appropriate. Matern-2.5 with low noise floor lets the GP capture the sharp peak without over-smoothing. No input warp needed yet in 2D with sparse data.

constrained_planning.allocation_strategy: 56% of experiments (9: ids 1-7,15,16) target top 4 regions (acq>103). 25% (4: ids 8-10,12) target regions 5-7 (acq 84-100). 19% (3: ids 13,14,11) cover boundary/validation including regions 10,12 and replication near current best.

Region 11 (T=400, pH~5.8) skipped — far from promising zone and at boundary. Region 13 (T~354, pH~4.85) covered approximately by exp 11. 8 unique T values (304, 327, 330, 335, 346, 350, 362, 373, 396→9, fits if we use 9 rows or consolidate).
